meaning.en: Om, now we take up the Surya Atharvangirasa hymn
meaning.hi: ॐ, अब सूर्याथर्वांगिरस का विवरण लेते हैं

meaning.en: its seer is Brahma
meaning.hi: इसके द्रष्टा ब्रह्मा हैं

meaning.en: its meter is Gayatri
meaning.hi: छंद गायत्री है

meaning.en: its deity is the sun
meaning.hi: देवता सूर्य हैं

meaning.en: the seed-syllables, 'I am That', joined with fire and Narayana
meaning.hi: बीज-अक्षर, अग्नि-नारायण से युक्त

meaning.en: its power is Hrillekha
meaning.hi: इसकी शक्ति हृल्लेखा है

meaning.en: the fixing element weaves in space and the rest of creation
meaning.hi: स्थिरकारक तत्त्व आकाश आदि सृष्टि से युक्त

meaning.en: used to attain all four aims of human life
meaning.hi: चतुर्विध पुरुषार्थ सिद्धि हेतु प्रयोग

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: carried by a six-note seed-sound, complete with six limbs
meaning.hi: षट्स्वर बीज, षडंग सहित

meaning.en: seated on a red lotus
meaning.hi: लाल कमल पर विराजमान

meaning.en: riding a chariot of seven horses, golden in color
meaning.hi: सात अश्वों के रथ पर, स्वर्ण-वर्ण

meaning.en: four-armed, two hands holding lotuses, two offering fearlessness and blessing
meaning.hi: चतुर्भुज, दो हाथ कमल, दो अभय-वरद

meaning.en: the one who sets the wheel of time turning
meaning.hi: कालचक्र का प्रवर्तक

words.sanskrit: shri-surya-narayanam ya evam veda sa vai brahmanah

meaning.en: whoever knows Shri Suryanarayana this way is truly a knower of Brahman
meaning.hi: जो श्री सूर्यनारायण को इस प्रकार जानता है वही सच्चा ब्राह्मण है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Om, earth, sky, heaven
meaning.hi: ॐ, भूः, भुवः, स्वः

words.sanskrit: om tat savitur varenyam bhargo devasya dhimahi

meaning.en: Om, we hold in mind the wonderful brightness of the divine Sun
meaning.hi: ॐ, उस दिव्य सूर्य के तेज को मन में धारण करते हैं

meaning.en: may that brightness stir our understanding forward
meaning.hi: वह हमारी बुद्धि को प्रेरित करे

meaning.en: the sun is the soul of all, moving and unmoving
meaning.hi: सूर्य चर-अचर जगत की आत्मा है

words.sanskrit: suryat vai khalu imani bhutani jayante

meaning.en: truly, from the sun all these beings are born
meaning.hi: सूर्य से ही ये सब प्राणी उत्पन्न होते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: from the sun come sacrifice, rain, food, and life
meaning.hi: सूर्य से यज्ञ, वर्षा, अन्न, आत्मा

meaning.en: salutations to you, O sun
meaning.hi: आपको नमस्कार, हे आदित्य

meaning.en: you alone are the doer of every action, plainly visible
meaning.hi: आप ही प्रत्यक्ष कर्मकर्ता हैं

meaning.en: you alone are Brahma, Vishnu, and Rudra, plainly visible
meaning.hi: आप ही प्रत्यक्ष ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, रुद्र हैं

meaning.en: you alone are the four Vedas, plainly visible
meaning.hi: आप ही प्रत्यक्ष चारों वेद हैं

meaning.en: you alone are every sacred meter
meaning.hi: आप ही समस्त छंद हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: from the sun the wind is born
meaning.hi: सूर्य से वायु उत्पन्न होती है

meaning.en: from the sun the earth is born
meaning.hi: सूर्य से पृथ्वी उत्पन्न होती है

meaning.en: from the sun the waters are born
meaning.hi: सूर्य से जल उत्पन्न होते हैं

meaning.en: from the sun light is born
meaning.hi: सूर्य से प्रकाश उत्पन्न होता है

meaning.en: from the sun the sky and directions are born
meaning.hi: सूर्य से आकाश-दिशाएँ उत्पन्न होती हैं

meaning.en: from the sun the gods are born
meaning.hi: सूर्य से देवता उत्पन्न होते हैं

meaning.en: from the sun the Vedas are born
meaning.hi: सूर्य से वेद उत्पन्न होते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: adityah vai esha etat mandalam tapati

meaning.en: it is the sun that heats this entire orbit
meaning.hi: सूर्य ही इस मंडल को तपाता है

meaning.en: that sun is Brahman itself
meaning.hi: वह सूर्य साक्षात् ब्रह्म है

meaning.en: the sun is the inner instrument, mind, intellect, awareness, ego
meaning.hi: सूर्य अंतःकरण, मन, बुद्धि, चित्त, अहंकार है

meaning.en: the sun is truly the five life-currents
meaning.hi: सूर्य सचमुच पाँच प्राण-प्रवाह हैं

meaning.en: the sun is truly hearing, touch, sight, taste, smell
meaning.hi: सूर्य सचमुच श्रवण, स्पर्श, दृष्टि, रस, गंध हैं

meaning.en: the sun is truly speech, hands, feet, and the organs of action
meaning.hi: सूर्य सचमुच वाणी, हाथ, पैर, कर्मेंद्रियाँ हैं

meaning.en: the sun is truly sound, touch, form, taste, fragrance
meaning.hi: सूर्य सचमुच शब्द, स्पर्श, रूप, रस, गंध हैं

meaning.en: the sun is the power behind speaking, receiving, moving, releasing, joy
meaning.hi: सूर्य वचन, आदान, गमन, विसर्ग, आनंद की शक्ति है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the sun is made of bliss, knowledge, deep understanding
meaning.hi: सूर्य आनंदमय, ज्ञानमय, विज्ञानमय है

words.sanskrit: namo mitraya bhanave mrityor ma pahi

meaning.en: salutations to Mitra, the shining one, protect us from death
meaning.hi: मित्र और भानु को नमस्कार, मृत्यु से रक्षा करें

meaning.en: salutations to the blazing one, cause of the universe
meaning.hi: दैदीप्यमान, विश्व के कारण को नमस्कार

words.sanskrit: suryat bhavanti bhutani suryena palitani tu

meaning.en: beings are born from the sun and sustained by the sun
meaning.hi: सूर्य से प्राणी जन्मते और उसी से पलते हैं

words.sanskrit: surye layam prapnuvanti yah suryah so'ham eva cha

meaning.en: they come to rest in the sun, and that sun I too am
meaning.hi: वे सूर्य में लय पाते हैं, वही सूर्य मैं हूँ

meaning.en: Savitr, our divine light, gives the eye its sight
meaning.hi: सविता देव हमारी दृष्टि हैं

meaning.en: as one knows a mountain by its shape against the sky
meaning.hi: जैसे पर्वत को उसके आकार से पहचाना जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: may the giver of sight give us sight
meaning.hi: दृष्टि के दाता हमें दृष्टि दें

meaning.en: we hold in mind the sun of a thousand rays
meaning.hi: हम हज़ार किरणों वाले सूर्य को धारण करते हैं

meaning.en: may that sun stir us forward
meaning.hi: वह सूर्य हमें प्रेरित करे

words.sanskrit: savita pashchattat savita purastat savita uttaratat savita adharatat

meaning.en: Savitr is behind, in front, above, below us
meaning.hi: सविता पीछे, आगे, ऊपर, नीचे हैं

meaning.en: may Savitr grant us every kind of well-being
meaning.hi: सविता हमें सर्वकल्याण दें

meaning.en: may Savitr give us a long life
meaning.hi: सविता हमें दीर्घ आयु दें

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Om is the single syllable that is Brahman
meaning.hi: ॐ वह एक अक्षर है जो ब्रह्म है

meaning.en: 'Ghrini' adds two syllables
meaning.hi: घृणि से दो अक्षर

meaning.en: 'Surya' adds two syllables
meaning.hi: सूर्य से दो अक्षर

meaning.en: 'Aditya' contributes three syllables
meaning.hi: आदित्य से तीन अक्षर

meaning.en: together, the eight-syllable formula of this sun
meaning.hi: इसी सूर्य का आठ-अक्षर मंत्र

words.sanskrit: yah sada ahah-ahah japati sa vai brahmanah bhavati

meaning.en: whoever recites it daily truly becomes worthy of the name Brahmin
meaning.hi: जो प्रतिदिन जपता है वह सच्चा ब्राह्मण बनता है

meaning.en: reciting facing the sun frees one from fear of serious illness
meaning.hi: सूर्य की ओर मुख कर जपने से रोग-भय से मुक्ति

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: misfortune melts away
meaning.hi: दुर्भाग्य पिघल जाता है

meaning.en: one becomes clean even from eating what shouldn't be eaten
meaning.hi: अभक्ष्य भक्षण से भी शुद्धि

meaning.en: one becomes clean even from going where one shouldn't
meaning.hi: अगम्य-गमन से भी शुद्धि

meaning.en: one becomes clean even from speaking with the fallen
meaning.hi: पतित-संभाषण से भी शुद्धि

meaning.en: one becomes clean even from speaking untruths
meaning.hi: असत्-संभाषण से भी शुद्धि

meaning.en: let this be read at midday, facing the sun
meaning.hi: मध्याह्न में सूर्याभिमुख पाठ करें

meaning.en: freed at once from five gravest, newly committed wrongs
meaning.hi: नए किए पाँच महापापों से तुरंत मुक्ति

words.sanskrit: saisham savitrim vidyam na kinchit api na kasmaichit prashamsayet

meaning.en: this sun-teaching should never be boasted or carelessly praised to anyone
meaning.hi: इस सावित्री विद्या की डींग या असावधान प्रशंसा न करें

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yah etam maha-bhagah pratah pathati sa bhagyavan jayate

meaning.en: whoever, greatly blessed, recites it in the morning becomes fortunate
meaning.hi: जो सुबह पढ़ता है वह भाग्यशाली बनता है

meaning.en: gains cattle
meaning.hi: पशुधन प्राप्त करता है

meaning.en: comes to understand the true meaning of the Vedas
meaning.hi: वेदों का सच्चा अर्थ पाता है

meaning.en: reciting it three times a day earns the merit of a hundred rites
meaning.hi: त्रिकाल जप से सौ यज्ञों का फल

words.sanskrit: yah hasta-aditye japati sa maha-mrityum tarati ya evam veda

meaning.en: whoever recites with hands to the sun crosses past the fear of death, once truly known
meaning.hi: सूर्य को हाथ जोड़ जपने वाला मृत्यु-भय पार कर जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
